change_summary: SPI register-based external multi-channel motor driver architecture pattern.

key_characteristics.mainfunction_reason: Periodic register polling for chip status, diagnostics and background state machine

external_apis.name: Gp_TLE92104_Init
external_apis.description: Initializes driver, loads config, sets up per-core runtime.

external_apis.name: Gp_TLE92104_MainFunction
external_apis.description: Periodic processing: register polling, fault debounce, state machine progression.

external_apis.name: Gp_TLE92104_SetDevModeOutSig
external_apis.description: Sets chip operating mode via SPI register write.

external_apis.name: Gp_TLE92104_GetDevModeInSig
external_apis.description: Reads current chip mode from cached runtime state.

external_apis.name: Gp_TLE92104_GetDevFaultSig
external_apis.description: Returns confirmed fault/diagnostic status from register polling.

dependency_apis.name: Gp_TLE92104_CalloutSpiTransceive
dependency_apis.prototype: Std_ReturnType Gp_TLE92104_CalloutSpiTransceive(uint16 Id_u16, uint16* TxData_pu16, uint16* RxData_pu16, uint16 Size_u16)
dependency_apis.description: SPI synchronous transmit/receive for register access.

dependency_apis.name: Gp_TLE92104_CalloutDioWrite
dependency_apis.description: DIO output for EN/RESET control pins.

dependency_apis.name: Gp_TLE92104_CalloutGetCoreId
dependency_apis.description: Returns current core ID for per-core runtime selection.

config_params.name: Gp_TLE92104_DioPinMap_au16
config_params.purpose: Maps logical pin index to physical DIO channel ID for EN/RESET.

runtime_states.name: ModeState_e
runtime_states.read_write_side: Written by Init/SetDevMode/MainFunction; read by GetDevMode.
runtime_states.lifecycle: Set to UNINIT at load; transitions managed by Init and MainFunction.

runtime_states.name: FaultState
runtime_states.read_write_side: Written by MainFunction; read by GetDevFaultSig.
runtime_states.lifecycle: Zeroed in Init; updated each MainFunction cycle.

memmap_sections.name: RUNTIME RAM
memmap_sections.target_content: Mode state, fault flags, debounce counters, DET buffer.

memmap_sections.name: REG CONST
memmap_sections.target_content: Register addresses, bit masks, command words.
